title: RTEC harassment-prevention / anti-retaliation procedure — FY2015 archive
source_path: Affirmative Action Plan (AAP)/AAP Plans (Old)/AAP INFO FY 2015/RTEC HARRASSMENT PREVENTION PROCEDURES.doc
rules: Employees and applicants are protected from harassment, intimidation, threats, coercion or discrimination for filing a complaint, assisting in a review/investigation/hearing, or otherwise seeking legal rights related to EEO for qualified individuals with disabilities or qualified protected veterans.
The procedure also tells employees/applicants who believe they have experienced harassment or discrimination because of a protected status to contact the EEO Manager for assistance.
The source states that the policy is communicated to employees and supervisors annually.
The source states that a notice is posted in the Human Resource office.
durable_process_signals: Anti-retaliation protection is not limited to the original complainant; participation in investigation/review/hearing activity is also protected.
Annual employee/supervisor communication and a physical HR posting were part of the historical control environment.
The EEO role served as an assistance/intake point.
currentness_boundary: This FY2015 procedure is historical and must not control current routing or contact information.
Current anti-retaliation and EEO authority are governed by the later 2025 handbook and signed 2026 EEO policy.
The misspelled historical filename/title ('HARRASSMENT') is retained only for provenance.
automation_candidates: Annual EEO/anti-retaliation policy acknowledgement and manager communication log.
Compliance check confirming current required notices/postings are present and version-correct.
Link retaliation concerns to the restricted employee-relations/EEO complaint case workflow rather than creating a separate uncontrolled intake channel.
